hint: WriteProtection.SetPassword only restricts editing, it does NOT encrypt the file. The document remains fully readable without a password. For true encryption use OoxmlSaveOptions { Password = "..." } or DocSaveOptions { Password = "..." } passed to doc.Save().

Mustache-style {{field}} placeholders require doc.MailMerge.UseNonMergeFields = true; set this immediately before the Execute() or ExecuteWithRegions() call, otherwise the placeholders are treated as plain text and no substitution occurs.

Building a watermark by manually constructing a Shape with ShapeType.TextPlainText is the pre-19.2 approach. Use the dedicated Watermark class: doc.Watermark.SetText(text, new TextWatermarkOptions { FontFamily = "Arial", FontSize = 40, Color = Color.LightGray, Layout = WatermarkLayout.Diagonal }).

Saving to a MemoryStream and then calling File.WriteAllBytes buffers the entire document in RAM. For large documents use a FileStream directly: new FileStream(path, FileMode.Create) and pass it to doc.Save(stream, format).

Setting LoadOptions.LoadFormat alone has no effect on memory usage. To reduce peak memory when loading large documents add MemoryOptimization = true to the LoadOptions initializer: new LoadOptions { LoadFormat = ..., MemoryOptimization = true }.
